subject: Norwich thump Bristol City 5-0 and home fans turn on Michael Skubala
title: Norwich five-nil at Ashton Gate

lines.vo: Five-nil away, and the home fans chanted for their own manager's sacking.
Norwich won five-nil at Ashton Gate. Five goals, five different scorers.
Paris Maghoma, Harry Darling, Andre Brooks and Jovon Makama scored. Mathias Kvistgaarden added a penalty. Very fair sharing.
Bristol fans booed at half-time. Later, they chanted for Michael Skubala to be sacked.

lines.vo: Skubala apologised and called the second half unacceptable. Honest, at least.
lines.footage: Michael Skubala press conference Bristol City

lines.vo: It was Bristol City's fifth home league defeat of the season.
Norwich have scored nine goals in two successive away wins. Norwich love an away day. Bristol City are struggling to enjoy a home one.
